title: Return Authorizations Held Across a Customer's Orders
content:
A Marlowe & Finch customer may hold any number of Returns & Exchanges return authorizations across their orders at the same time. There is no cap per customer (the per-customer limit is set to none, with no figure). The only count limit on authorizations is per order, set by the per-order return limit.

| Situation | Effect of the per-customer rule |
|---|---|
| A customer has open returns on several different orders | No limit arises from the number of orders or returns held |
| A customer asks to open a return on an order that already carries returns | The per-order limit is what is checked, not a per-customer total |

Example (hypothetical): a customer holding open Store Credit Returns on four different orders who starts a Standard Return on a fifth order meets no per-customer limit; only the fifth order's own count of open return authorizations is read.
